question: How far do small fits predict later log loss and the choice of source mix or scorer on fixed unseen recordings? Retrospective across previously studied evaluation sets.
endpoint: At the close of each occupied complete (left,right] millisecond, predict the local sorted unit of the next occupied bin. Score only if it contains exactly one spike. All complete bins including multi-spike bins update history. Exclude partial edges, reset on each source trial, censor last bin, retain entire prespecified roster including silent units. No cross-recording identity alignment. Target time and gap unavailable at issuance.

training.rat: All 24 JS14/01 source trials 55–78 only, sorted local unit roster, 54578 eligible unique transitions. No trial 79 or later used for any purpose.
training.salamander: Three Loback experiments, all deposited spike trains. First ten full eligible repeat rows, first 10 seconds per repeat. Follow published strict native 10 kHz clock procedure, reject local within-unit order inversions, never replace rejected windows. Pool the 28 qualified windows from those recordings. Do not assume independent animals.

arms.mixed: N/2 unique JS14 origins plus N/2 unique salamander origins. This is replacement at equal total budget.

training.sampling: Each seed independently uniformly permutes resolved within-source training origins without replacement. Use its prefix in each budget and the same rat ordering in both arms. Scatter selected indices back to their original trial and issue ordinal. The full rat reference and its nonlinear counterpart are identical across seeds by design. Prior spike history in each selected trial remains visible when forming features. Scale counts label examples, not total raw observations or independent animals.

scorers.linear5: Conditional softmax across local candidates. Five shared slopes from the rat benchmark: log cumulative count, log1p of 10/100/1000 ms decayed counts, and last-bin-fired indicator. No intercept or identity embedding.
scorers.hinge13: Same five slopes plus eight learned coefficients on fixed ReLU hinges. Two thresholds per first four features: [1,3], [0.25,0.8], [0.5,1.5], [0.8,2]. All threshold locations fixed before fitting. This is a modest one-hidden-layer piecewise-linear score with fixed hidden units, not a Transformer.

training.optimization: Both minimize mean event NLL plus 0.00005 times squared coefficient norm. Float64, zero initialization, deterministic full-batch L-BFGS-B; maxiter 250, ftol 1e-10, gtol 1e-7. No test selection, early stopping, hyperparameter tuning or model pruning. Reuse original exact full-rat linear5 weights after verifying training provenance and code identity; report optimization convergence. Resolve any execution failures without changing scientific criteria.

held.ER1: Rat ER1/01, first ten independent held recording trial rows 0–9, all 122 candidates. All 10 held together.
held.turtle: Entire recording held from weight fitting. Established 20 kHz integer clock. For the primary score the earlier 20 initialization windows define 103 observed IDs; evaluate the next 20 non-overlapping 3 s windows with trial censoring on newly observed IDs. Additional score on all 109 declared clusters with no roster censoring. No turtle fit, selection or calibration.
held.claims: Both held files were studied previously, including the full-rat linear5 baseline. The current matched learning curves, hinge fits and forecasts are retrospective. Species, task, hardware, tissue and lab differ together.

metrics: Primary is equal-held-trial mean natural log loss for each recording and roster. Preserve pooled and equal-target log loss/top1, fractional top1 ties and midrank, target counts/rosters, per-trial metrics, training-origin/ordinal membership hashes, baseline uniform/rate/recency. 5000 paired resamples of whole held trials within recording using fixed seed 20261121 and averages across three training seeds. Seed ranges separately. Consecutive trials within one recording cannot supply between-animal confidence intervals.
forecast: Before any largest-budget scoring, write and SHA256 seal smaller-run results and per-recording predicted largest losses and order over four source-by-scorer choices. Primary forecast carries the 16384 seed-mean score forward (plateau assumption). Sensitivity extrapolates the 4096-to-16384 change linearly in log2 training count to 54578. Also compare 1024-only ranks vs actual. No posthoc recommendation or tuning on held trials. Report absolute errors, winner agreement and pairwise rank agreement, source differences with descriptive uncertainty, by held recording. Do not pool recordings with different rosters or claim extrapolation to millions of examples.
